read_flow_from_flo_file: read an optical flow Middlebury .flo file and return the flow data as a numpy array
write_flow_to_flo_file: write an optical flow numpy array to a Middlebury .flo format file on disk
convert_flow_to_color_image: convert an optical flow map into a Middlebury color-coded image for visualization
evaluate_flow_end_point_error: evaluate the end point error between ground truth and predicted optical flow files
warp_image_with_flow: warp an image to the next frame using an optical flow field with cubic interpolation
